# FRTB sensitivities (`frtb-sensitivity` v1)

Delta, vega and curvature by risk class and bucket (SBM).

**Group:** Market risk · **Mnemonic:** `FRTB` · **Identifiers:** `FRTB-…` in `resultId`

Open one with `FRTB <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: frtb-sensitivity
version: 1
description: "Delta, vega and curvature by risk class and bucket (SBM)."
match: { kind: frtb-sensitivity, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market risk · FRTB sensitivities, id: $.resultId }
strip:
  - { label: Book, bind: $.book }
  - { label: Delta charge, bind: $.deltaCharge, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Vega charge, bind: $.vegaCharge, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Curvature, bind: $.curvatureCharge, fmt: compact }
  - { label: SBM total, bind: $.total, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
panels:
  - id: buckets
    kind: table
    title: Sensitivities
    key: F2
    rows: $.sensitivities
    columns:
      - { label: Risk class, bind: "@.riskClass" }
      - { label: Bucket, bind: "@.bucket" }
      - { label: Measure, bind: "@.measure" }
      - { label: Value, bind: "@.value", fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - id: classes
    kind: hbar
    title: Charge by risk class
    area: right
    rows: $.byClass
    label: riskClass
    value: charge
    fmt: compact
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.book, 'book')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
